definition: every one, with none left out
description: A supermarket fruit section. A young woman with a dark ponytail, in a grey sweatshirt and black trousers, pushes and steers a shopping trolley piled impossibly high with a tower of whole watermelons, struggling to keep it straight. Next to her the wooden fruit display is completely empty, and watermelons lie on the tiled floor. A young shop worker in a green apron holding a clipboard stares at her, and an elderly couple watch in surprise from the aisle.

de.answer: Sie schiebt einen Einkaufswagen voller Wassermelonen.
de.question: Was schiebt die Frau?

es.answer: Está empujando un carrito lleno de sandías.
phrases: empujar un carrito de la compra
es.question: ¿Qué está empujando la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle pousse un chariot plein de pastèques.
